# Chenyu Jin, MPH

Biostatistics | Epidemiology | Population Health
:::

I am a public health researcher with an MPH degree in Biostatistics and an Advanced Certificate in Epidemiology from Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health. I also hold a BSc degree in Financial Mathematics from Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool University.

My research interests include survival analysis, statistical learning, and causal inference, with applications in cancer epidemiology and population health.
